findings.one_line: The promised honest growing-path band is replaced by a generic conditional transfer whose nonlinear-remainder and feasible-score probability controls are neither established for the stated class nor operationalized, so the current headline is not a usable uniform-coverage deliverable.
The sole scalar K=1 reduction does not supply the required panel sanity reductions for homogeneous effects, no carry-over, and T=2 to canonical DID (or a named special case).

Xia--Yuan (2021), Choi--Kwon--Liao (2026), Athey et al. (2021), Ben-Michael--Feller--Rothstein (2022), and Chernozhukov--Wuthrich--Zhu (2021) appear in the bibliography without relevance or theorem-level comparison, leaving the positioning review incomplete.
